title: Round 19: Digger, Grandpa, Alchemist, Shaman, Witch

cards.title: Five casters, your notes
cards.text: Digger, Grandpa, Alchemist, Shaman and Witch from every 0.19 note. Live in 0.30.0.
cards.why: Mark any part that's off. The bear and salmon sketches and my calls are the cards after this.

parts.title: Digger
parts.text: Spade: an earth swing; clods burst out behind each foe hit, not on their own. Burrow: solid churned trail with big clumps that holds then goes fast; a mound where he goes in and comes up. Dirt Fling makes foes Dirty: their buffs wash off, the spade does double and knocks the dirt off. Bury: held under a mound, comes up dirty; only burrowers can move under it.

parts.title: Grandpa Sickle
parts.text: Bread: no steam, one shadow, lands on the friend's middle; his own loaf goes up and back into his hands. Harvest: a dash along the floor, then a full circular sweep that does the cutting. Old Tales is now Sheaves: four hay bundles planted round him; friends step on them to heal, enemies that break them get hayed, and hitting a hayed foe speeds your cooldowns.

parts.title: Alchemist
parts.text: They throw skinny corked tubes like the vials on their head. Brew Pools: frost mist and snowflakes, ripples, fizzing sparks, a mint whirlpool. Monstrosity: drinks a purple tube, turns purple with big fists, punches left and right, knocks far, runs fast. Elixir II throws two tubes to two friends.

parts.title: Shaman
parts.text: Spirit bolt shows in the Book. Totem: matches the one on his back, bursts on landing, light orbs fly into it from hit friends, collides only at its foot. Ancestors' Call: a new lean wolf and an eagle with a white head, finger feathers and a fan tail, drawn above everyone. Spirit Link: threads to every friend, teal light running along them.

parts.title: Witch
parts.text: Hex bolts are glowing angular runes. Broom Ride: she stays visible, the broom under her, not in her hand. Cursed Brew: a cauldron from above with a round mouth, the same pot thrown as lands. Hex: a proper top-down frog that blinks and kicks.

cards.title: The bear
cards.text: A big bear seen from above, in the Bearskin's colours. Approve, and I'll make the spirit bear from it?
cards.why: You asked to approve the normal bear before it becomes a spirit. It's beside the Bearskin and the current spirit bear for size.
cards.pick: Yes, make the spirit version from it.

cards.title: The salmon
cards.text: A top-down salmon, in its own colours and in spirit blue. Use it as a spirit?
cards.why: You asked to try one. It stands for the way home and coming back; it isn't in the game yet.
cards.pick: Yes, as a spirit that heals whoever it swims through.

cards.title: Calls in the casters
cards.text: Four readings of your notes, made while building. Details on the back.
cards.why: Each changes how a hero plays. All easy to change.
cards.details:
1. Dirty 'clears enemies' effects': I read it as washing off their helpful buffs (rage, haste, shields), not their burning or poison.

2. Sheaves' '15% boost': each blow on a hayed foe makes the striker's waiting abilities recharge 15% faster for 3 s.

3. Elixir: tier II is your two tubes; the strong brews moved from tier II to III.

4. Broom Ride: now that she's visible she can be targeted, but she flies, so only shots reach her. Her bombs went up a little (0.9 to 1.0 of her damage, cooldown 11 to 10 s) to keep her strength.

cards.title: What each animal means
cards.text: You asked what each of the Shaman's animals stands for.
cards.why: Bear: strength and shelter. Wolf: the hunt and the pack. Eagle: sight from above, and healing. Beaver: patience, work that lasts. Salmon: the way home.
